title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind — Episode5 A Work Update

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...so a lot of things happened after that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, did that lady make it in time for the shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I told the receptionist what was going on, and they said they'd show her in from there! So, I'm sure everything worked out!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, talk about a busy day...
On top of going house hunting, you saved that old lady and had a meeting afterwards. I'm sure you're all tired...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, how did that meeting go?
Can you tell us what this show you're gonna be on is like?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's why we're here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a late night talk show in the eleven o'clock slot. It's hosted by a famous comedian and they have a different set of guests on each week...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is where we come in.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means you'll be joined by other guests. Do you already know who they are?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A model named Yuika and an influencer named MYU!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only are they both pretty famous, but the comedian hosting this show, Mr. Arimura, is one of the biggest names in the business. I'm getting nervous just thinking about that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He's that famous...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's incredible that you get to work alongside such celebrities.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't this the most high-profile offer MORE MORE JUMP! has ever received?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. The studio's so big that there's even room for a live audience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is the first time we'll have an audience watching as we do a shoot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so excited♪ What do you think that's gonna be like...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get your excitement, but we've still gotta come up with a good talk segment.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A talk segment?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A part of the show involves segments that the guests come up with themselves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Some past examples include making hamburgers with your favorite ingredients and trying to win 10,000 yen from the lottery.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see. And now you have to come up with one for yourselves...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That sounds both fun and difficult at the same time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Unlike your usual streams, the viewers of this show won't all necessarily know who you are. That means your segment needs to appeal to a wider audience.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. We have a lot to do in a short amount of time, but I'm sure we'll be able to figure something out by working together...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, we need to stay sharp since we have that interview afterwards to see if we can turn that place into the MORE MORE HOUSE.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're super busy all of a sudden...
Please try to be mindful of your health.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Len!
We promise to be extra careful!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. We'll be rooting for you.
And I can't wait to see this show.
The day of the shoot
TV Station - Studio

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Alright, let's have our resident fashionista give her verdict!

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
Who's more fashionable...?
It is Airi, or is it Minori?

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line: Personally, I don't think “cute” is the right word for what I'm seeing... I'd have to go with “interesting”...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Th-Th-This was my attempt at a street look since I don't often wear these kinds of clothes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This cap with a bandana tied around it is one of its biggest selling points.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
W-Wait just right there!
No one said anything about us giving presentations on our outfits!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And I've got plenty to say!
Check out the king crabs on these socks! Talk about a cute touch! Aren't they adorable...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-If we're gonna talk about nice touches, you should see the design on the shirt I'm wearing underneath!

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line: No, that's not fair since we can't see it right now. Also, not being able to come up with the word “undershirt” makes you sound like a fashion novice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even though it's her first time on this kind of variety show, Minori's doing an incredible job.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She says funny things without having to think about it, which really helps with these kinds of shows. I'm actually a little jealous...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm a novice when it comes to fashion, but I took a stab at trying something new! My socks are each a different color and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, no presenting! How long do you plan on yammering on?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi's also doing well with her quips.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But Airi would never wear this sort of outfit. I guess she went with it for the sake of the show...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And the audience seems to be enjoying everything... We should be fine as long as we can keep this up.)

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: And the winner of Yuika's Idol Fashion Check is... Minori! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line: Choosing an outfit that uses five different types of fabrics was pretty interesting, and your presentation was fun to see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Grr... But my ocean-themed outfit...
I worked so hard to find clothes with crabs, crayfish and hermit crabs on them...!

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: I honestly thought it was a coin toss in the end, but it's also clear that Yuika knows her stuff when it comes to fashion!

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
Anyway, that concludes her segment!
And thank you both for participating, Airi, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much!
We'll be taking a short break here!

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
We'll resume in twenty minutes.
Any members of the audience that need to use the facilities should do so now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work back there.
That segment Yuika came up with ended up being a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You made all those great quips, Airi, and I really liked the outfit you picked out, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I sorta jumped when I heard that my opponent would be Airi, but I'm so glad I ended up winning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, does this mean I have talent?
Am I really a fashionable person?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If that's your takeaway, I'm extremely jealous of how happy-go-lucky you are...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, we did our segment right at the beginning, and it went well. All we have left is MYU's segment. We'll be done after that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but we don't have any breaks left, so we need to stay sharp until the end.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I should go to the restroom while I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It should be somewhere over on the left after you exit the studio. Just be careful not to get lost on your way back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, be right back!
se_walk_women_002_1
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew... Thank goodness!
I managed to find my way back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought I was gonna get lost since the hallways in these kinds of TV stations all look the same...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hi, Minori!
Your shoot's been going really well!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Were you watching?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, we've all been watching from inside your pocket!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That fashion check segment was really good! I'd love to see it again after it airs.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You liked it that much...?!
Hehe. I really appreciate you saying that since I also had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The audience also seemed to enjoy everything. They were laughing and applauding the whole time...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm also glad they're having such a fun time! Getting direct feedback like this has been really great, so I wanna keep doing my best after our break and...

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ａ
rows.Line:
So, where'd the original guests go?
Why is MORE MORE JUMP! or whoever here instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ａ
rows.Line: I was really looking forward to seeing LiLia here today. I mean, that's why I applied to be a member of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ｂ
rows.Line:
Oh, they're overseas right now.
Apparently, they're having trouble flying back due to bad weather.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ａ
rows.Line:
Wow, really?
So that's how those other girls ended up taking their place?

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ａ
rows.Line:
I mean, these things happen.
And MORE MORE JUMP! is trying their best...

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ｂ
rows.Line: But I still wish LiLia were here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's understandable. They applied to be a part of the audience because they wanted to see a specific group...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I'd be disappointed too if I were put in the same situation.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I mean... Yes, that is understandable...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We were sure that we could make today's shoot fun for everyone by doing what we always do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we really should've thought more about how we're replacing someone else...
Minori? Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Hello.
It's good to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're that lady from the other day...!
